_instructions: Annual corporate partners shown in 'Our corporate partners' on /corporate-partnerships/.
Add a partner ONLY after the trustees have approved the partnership and the business has agreed to be listed.
Each partner is shown only when 'approved' is true and today's date is between 'start' and 'end' (inclusive), so expired partnerships drop off by themselves.

Fields: name (required); tier: 'Community Partner', 'Impact Partner' or 'Foundation Partner'; logo: path from the site root such as 'assets/partners/business-name.webp' (only with the business's permission), or null to show the name instead; website: full https:// address (only if approved), or null; start and end: dates as YYYY-MM-DD; approved: true or false.

Example entry (copy into 'partners' and edit): { "name": "Business Name Ltd", "tier": "Community Partner", "logo": null, "website": null, "start": "2027-01-01", "end": "2027-12-31", "approved": false }
